data.one_liner: GPU-powered progressive and variable blur effects for Flutter.
data.what_it_does: Provides modern progressive blur effects using custom GPU shaders. It includes both backdrop blur and child blur widgets supporting directional fades, geometric shapes, custom masks, and color adjustments.
use_when: You need variable or progressive blur intensities (e.g. fading gradients) that Flutter does not natively support.
You want to build glassmorphic UI elements like iOS-style system bars or blurred cards.
You are targeting platforms that support custom shaders and Impeller.
avoid_when: You only require a simple uniform blur that can be handled out-of-the-box by standard Flutter widgets without custom shaders.
Your target environment lacks proper GPU shader support.
strengths: GPU-accelerated custom shader implementation optimized for Impeller.
Supports both backdrop-level and child-level blur modes.
Extensive customization options including shapes, custom masks, color tinting, and color adjustments.
weaknesses: Relies on custom shaders and rendering pipelines, which may behave differently depending on device capabilities and fallback modes.
Complex layered layouts may require careful selection between imageFilter and animatedSampler modes.
data.setup_notes: It is recommended to call Inspire.warmUp() during app startup to pre-load shaders.
